source_sentence: One caveat is that in the definition for the AR successor order, ϕ2,2 ⊳′ (x, y), ϕ2,3 ⊳′ (x, y), ϕ3,2 ⊳′ (x, y), and ϕ3,3 ⊳′ (x, y) all used the string precedence predicate x ≺y, either directly in the definition or through the use of the predicate span(x, y).
title: On the Logical Complexity of Autosegmental Representations
